name: GAIN
description: To get more of what one did not have before; to grow in strength or wealth or knowledge

name: BELONG
description: To be part of a group or place; to have a right to be where one is, as if at home

name: SPIRIT
description: The inner nature that gives life its meaning; the part of a being that is not the body but the self within

name: CONSTANT
description: Never changing; staying the same through all time without stop or shift

name: METHOD
description: A way of doing something with order and thought; a chosen path to reach a goal

name: MESSAGE
description: Words sent from one to another; something said or written to carry meaning across distance

name: MAINTAIN
description: To keep something in its present state; to care for so that it does not fall apart or change

name: RETURN
description: To go back to a place or state that one was in before; to come again to where one began

name: VAPOR
description: Water or liquid turned to thin air by heat; the mist that rises from what is warm and wet

name: VITALITY
description: The living force within; the strength and energy that fills a being with the power to act and grow

name: DISTRESS
description: Deep suffering of the mind or body; pain that comes from within when all feels wrong

name: WITHDRAW
description: To pull back from a place or state; to move away from what was near and become apart

name: ADD
description: To put one thing with another so there is more; to join what is new to what was there before

name: INITIAL
description: Coming at the very start; the first of what is to come before all else

name: LET
description: To allow something to be or to happen; to not hold back or stop what would move or change

name: ABLE
description: Having the power or skill to do what is asked; strong or wise enough to meet a task

name: UNCERTAIN
description: Not sure; lacking clear knowledge of what is true or what will come next

name: FULFILLMENT
description: The deep feeling of having reached what was sought; the state where nothing more is needed

name: RESPONSIBILITY
description: The duty to care for something or answer for what one has done; a weight that is given to be held

name: ORGANIZATION
description: A group of people working together with order and purpose toward a shared goal
